title: Two-input tableau circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet, and let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$. The tableau circuit for $M$ with parameters $n,T$ is well formed, and each of its gates reads at most two input vertices.
